fields.name: RunWhenVisible
documentation: Run OnUpdate only while object is visible.

fields.name: RunWhenVisibleOnce
documentation: Run OnUpdate once while object is visible; resets to Disabled before running.

fields.name: RunOnce
documentation: Run OnUpdate once regardless of visibility; resets to Disabled before running.

fields.name: DenyTaintedAccessWhenAurasAreSecret
documentation: Denies access to this script object from tainted execution while aura information is secret.

fields.name: Hierarchy
documentation: Propagation through script object hierarchy relationships, such as parent-child ownership.

fields.name: Layout
documentation: Propagation through layout dependency relationships, such as frames anchored relative to one another.

predicates.Name: RequiresAssignableScript
Documentation: Requires that this object permit assignment of scripts of this type. May fail for reasons such as the script type not being supported, or secret aspects blocking assignments.

predicates.Name: RequiresSupportedScript
Documentation: Requires a valid script type supported by this object. If not supported, functions will return no values.
